reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual comparison of the exact native source, the complete unchanged raw RGB output, the complete white/cyan/alpha sheet and the unchanged naiwa mascot reference

entries.positive_observation: The near-frontal head tilt and gaze toward screen left remain, with short light brown/blond temple hair and separate light brown eyebrows. No monocle, spectacles or beard was added. The tilted navy peaked cap retains its gold emblem groups, black visor and braid; the navy broad-lapel jacket, white pointed shirt and black tie remain. One small serious mouth sits on a compact round yellow head with a short broad collar transition, no floating cloth or cream bib.
entries.alpha_decision: The source and returned RGB both retain a complete opaque cream-grey painted backing. Full white/cyan inspection shows no visible transparency, holes or backing loss. No alpha derivation was needed or performed.
entries.visible_limitations: Tiny cap relief and individual hair strands remain pixel-limited at 156x210; no unsupported microscopic claim is made.
